summary: The change shortens the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 10 minutes in both code and the approved parameter. That stays within SES-1's bound of 15 minutes or less, and the registered exhaustive control test passes on the head commit. The ticket, independent code review and control-owner approval are all valid and cover the final commit. No security-sensitive component is touched, no exception is relied on, no ledger evidence covers the changed code, and the change is not an emergency, so CHG-5, EXC-1, LAP-1 and CHG-7 do not apply. Every applicable obligation is shown, so the change is accepted.
